title: datachangelog: Evaluate and Log Changes in Data Records — datachangelog-package
text: Provides functionality evaluating logging changes data records datasets. aim package provide lightweight convenient option sharing changes data records (e.g. due data cleaning efforts).

title: Evaluate and log changes in data records — evaluate
text: function evaluate log changes data records two data.frame optionally create markdown changelog report.

title: Evaluate and log changes in data records — evaluate
code: evaluate(   x,   y,   by = "column",   id = NULL,   report = FALSE,   file = "CHANGELOG.md",   author = NULL,   date = NULL,   ver = NULL )

title: Evaluate and log changes in data records — evaluate
text: x data.frame. data.frame compare y. Treated original version data records. y data.frame. data.frame compare x. Treated replacement version data records. character. x y compared? Options include "column" (default), "row", "id". id character. name column treat unique identifiers comparing x y. applicable set "id". report logical. TRUE, verbose report written file. file character. Path, name, extension file saved. Defaults current working directory "CHANGELOG.md". author character. author report changelog report, requested. date character. data report changelog report, requested. default, current date used. ver character. version number report changelog report, requested.

title: Evaluate and log changes in data records — evaluate
text: data.frame containing data record comparison results. changes reported. report TRUE, changelog report also saved file.

title: Evaluate and log changes in data records — evaluate
text: function assumes input data.frames maintain structure aims evaluate whether existing record values changed (e.g. data cleaning).
